Welcome to 9to5Toys Lunch Break post-Prime Day deals roundup. Although the fall big Prime Day has ended, Apple's deals keep flowing, and today we pick out the best choices for you. Among them, the AirPods Pro 3 best-ever deal is still going, AirPods Max 2 is $120 off, M6 Mac mini hits a new low at $150 off, Apple Watch Series 12 models remain at all-time lows across the board, M5 MacBook Air models are $200 off, plus all-time low deals on Apple iPhone 18 Pro cases. Check out all the great deals below.

Sony BRAVIA TVs up to $1,000 off at Amazon — OLED, Mini-LED and more

Amazon Prime Day AirPods Pro 3 deal still live, nearly 30% off; AirPods Max 2 $120 off

Given how many deals were on offer yesterday, most have already gone back up in price now that Amazon has wrapped its fall Prime Day 2026 event. That's not the case with Apple products, however — you can still grab the fantastic AirPods Pro 3 at their best price yet, and pick up AirPods Max 2 with a hefty $120 discount.

As of writing, Amazon is offering the Apple AirPods Pro 3 down to $179 with shipping included.

That's a discount of nearly 30%, and one of the lowest prices we've ever recorded for what's arguably the most popular set of earbuds in the world.

Originally $249, now $70 off — how long this deal will last is anyone's guess. We've only seen it go for less on Amazon once, and that was a brief $169 flash deal during the four-day summer Prime Day event back in late June.

  • AirPods Pro 3 at $179 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 at $429 (originally $549)

Apple's more recently released AirPods Max 2 are also holding at their fall Prime Day pricing, and just like the Pro 3 above, Amazon has only ever gone lower once — this current deal sits just $30 above that one all-time low.

With $120 off, all five colors are still available at Amazon for $429 with shipping, and how long this will last is anyone's guess.

One of the best Prime Day deals of the year remains: M6 Mac mini up to $150 off

Although the fall edition of Prime Day is officially over, as we reported earlier, there are still plenty of great "leftover" deals hanging around (for now, at least). One of them is Apple's just-released M6 Mac mini. As of writing, you can still snag one with up to $150 off — easily making this the most "dark horse" Prime Day deal of the bunch.

As of this morning, Amazon still has a ton of great Apple deals going, but some are starting to disappear (mostly Apple Watch Series 12 models). How long the M6 Mac mini discounts will last is anyone's guess, but they were still live this morning:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB at $780 (originally $899) — just $11 above all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB at $950 (originally $1,099) — all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 24GB/512GB at $1,150 (originally $1,299) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB at $1,550 (originally $1,699) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio at $2,300 (originally $2,499) — all-time low

Here are all the new Apple Watch Series 12 models still at all-time lows from Prime Day

Although fall Prime Day 2026 wrapped up ages ago, it's not quite gone yet. Amazon is still offering holiday pricing on AirPods Pro 3, all-time low M6 Mac mini deals, and a whole host of Apple Watch Series 12 model deals. Below, we've rounded up all the models still at their historically lowest prices — some are already creeping back up, so act fast.
